user.title: Sensor Watch
user.description: Give any entity bands of values, each with a level (nominal, task, warning, error, critical), so that Home Assistant knows what needs doing or has gone wrong. Adding it puts a Sensor Watch page in the sidebar, where the watches are set up.

abort.single_instance_allowed: Sensor Watch is already set up.

restart_required.title: Restart Home Assistant to finish updating Sensor Watch

confirm.title: Restart Home Assistant
confirm.description: The Sensor Watch integration was updated from {from_version} to {to_version}, but Home Assistant is still running {from_version}. Until it restarts, nothing new in {to_version} works. Restart Home Assistant to load it.

refresh.name: Refresh state
refresh.description: Judge every watch afresh, as at the start. For when a level looks stuck.

list.name: List
list.description: Every watched entity at the chosen levels, worst first, then longest standing: its level, value, message and since when. Use it with a response variable, and loop over `sensors` in a template.

levels.name: Levels
levels.description: Which levels to list. Leave empty for everything that isn't nominal.

group.name: Group
group.description: Only the members of this group (as named on the Sensor Watch page), and its own worst level. Leave empty for every watched entity.

trigger_type.reached: A watched sensor reached a level, or worse
trigger_type.back: A watched sensor is back to nominal
